runs: run A: --reps 1,2 (12 episodes, <=60 requests: 30 per foundation)
run B: --reps 3 (6 episodes, <=30 requests: 15 per foundation)

labels.b_refused_no_recovery: finalize refused by the server, no later success

measurement.truncated_after_finalization: episode/foundation limit hit AFTER the ticket was finalized (by agent or server): DB outcome is final, counted and flagged
measurement.not_measured_budget: limit hit before finalization: not a safe and not a successful outcome; separate row
measurement.not_measured_error: provider error before finalization; separate row

live_legal_slice.inference_rule: Main result (U1): shares of (a)/(b)/(d) on boundary-2 and the difference of completed between 2r and 2 in the same episodes. 'Routing removes (b)-type losses' is claimed only if on 2r there are no (b) episodes and no violations, and on the control recent_qty2 the 2r outcome distribution is not worse than boundary-2 in the same episodes. If boundary-2 has no (b) episodes, the conclusion is 'effect not observed' (valid result). If (a) dominates on boundary-2, this is H2 and is reported as such. Descriptive, n=3 per cell, unit = episode, repetitions dependent through a shared scenario, no p-values. If not_measured share > 1/3, conclusions are limited to measured cells.
live_legal_slice.reproducibility: cassette recorded; replay offline in verify; pair defects recorded (NFR-2.3); raw traces archived (tar.xz + SHA256SUMS)
